name: Blackfathom Deeps
summary: Blackfathom Deeps lies flooded beneath the Zoram Strand on Ashenvale's northwestern coast. Its halls once honored Elune, but naga, satyr, and the Twilight's Hammer now hold the ruins.

sections.title: From Elune's Temple to Darkest Abyss
sections.body: Beneath Ashenvale's northwestern cliffs, flooded halls mark the remains of an ancient temple. Before the Great Sundering shattered Kalimdor ten thousand years ago, the temple honored Elune and held its own moonwell. When the Well of Eternity collapsed, the shrine sank beneath the waves and was presumed lost forever. Over millennia, shorelines receded and the ground shifted below, leaving the temple partly flooded beneath the cliffs.

sections.title: Aku'mai and the Cult
sections.body: The Twilight's Hammer has made its home in the flooded temple, under Twilight Lord Kelris. Corruption from an Old God has risen through the deep earth and tainted the sacred Moon Well. Aku'mai, a monstrous three-headed hydra and servant of the Old God, rose from its waters. Naga led by Lady Sarevess and prowling satyrs join the cultists, who sacrifice innocents to Aku'mai for power.

faq.q: What was Blackfathom Deeps originally built for?
faq.answer: Before it sank beneath the waves during the Sundering, Blackfathom Deeps was a night elven temple to Elune, with a sacred moonwell at its heart.

faq.q: Why is the Twilight's Hammer cult here?
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer came to worship Aku'mai, a primeval hydra and servant of an Old God. Under Twilight Lord Kelris, the cult sacrifices innocents to the beast for dark power.
The entrance lies among cavernous ruins along the Zoram Strand, on Ashenvale's far northwestern coast. You must pass through submerged chambers and hostile naga outposts to reach the temple portal.
Ghamoo-ra is a giant, maddened turtle that lurks on an island in one of the temple's flooded caverns. The turtle attacks any intruder who comes near.

angles.text: As a Kaldorei, you may mourn the defilement of this ancient shrine to Elune. Void cultists and naga have desecrated its sacred halls and moonwell.
As a member of the Horde, you know the deeps lie uncomfortably close to Zoram'gar. The cultists and naga gathering on the Zoram Strand threaten the outpost's defenders.
